rationale: Only point-in-time-complete SEC streams were backfilled (each CIK fetch returns full filed-date history). Daily PIT snapshot streams (kova fundamentals/rs_proxy/intraday daily, earnings snapshot, news) were deliberately NOT backfilled: reconstructing past daily snapshots would inject lookahead/fabricated PIT and break production/backtest parity -- those accrue forward via the fixed run.py only.
rate_limit_discipline: All SEC jobs run strictly sequentially (companyfacts breadth -> form4 -> sec_filing -> companyfacts --refresh) at 0.15s/req to respect SEC ~10 req/s per-IP fair-access; the --refresh job polled the backfill done-marker before starting so it never ran concurrently.
